difficulty: headings in ALL CAPS bold at body size, two code blocks, and a blockquote
title: Build Notes for the Ledger Service

headings.text: Build Notes for the Ledger Service

key_sentences: The ledger service is built from a single repository.
Install the toolchain before cloning the sources.
The service reads its settings from a small file at start-up.
Releases are cut from the main branch every second Tuesday.
Never tag a release while the nightly build is red.
The release manager signs the tag and publishes the notes.
code:
git clone https://example.org/ledger.git
cd ledger
make deps
make test VERBOSE=1

[server]
port = 8085
log_level = "info"

[storage]
path = "/var/lib/ledger"
    # keep the path absolute
